One row per subject; L1 listening to L1 writing and L2 listening to L2 writing are each subject's self-ratings of the same four skills in two languages, a subject by language structure stored wide; Experiment is a between-subject predictor of fixed levels.

One row per participant, each protection behavior's ratings as columns (RD02_1 to RD02_17, RD03_, RD04_); Analysis.Rmd pivots them into the behavior by participant table fitted with (1 | behavior) + (1 | participant).

One row per participant (Participant ID), the same questions answered for each movie clip as columns (Will this movie have a happy ending? to .4 and the open questions .1 onward); the paper's distance model (1 | pair) runs on pairwise distances computed from these answers.

One row per participant (Participant ID), the agreement rating and the same questions repeated per movie clip as columns (Rate your overall agreement with the group consensus about this movie clip: to .3, Will this movie have a happy ending? to .5); Collector ID is the survey link.
